description: Rotating file-level parse eval with cost-aware GT builds.

eval.note: Use llm-cost for rotating eval too — same pass profile as GT, with concurrency fan-out.

passNotes.extract_pages: Always required; local PDF I/O only.
passNotes.heuristic_classify: Always required; free routing to FileTypeProfile.
passNotes.llm_classify: Skip when heuristic confidence >= 0.82 (default parser behavior).
passNotes.llm_pass1: Always for LLM file parse; tool set varies by type.
passNotes.llm_pass2: Skip when profile.pass2=false OR pass1 had no log_* tools (runtime gate).
passNotes.finalize: Must not defer per-file finalize during GT/eval.
